newReport.alreadyExists: That committee already has a report for the day, so that one opens instead. Two reports for one day could not both be booked.

newReport.failed: The report could not be created.
newReport.emptyBody: This report holds no sales yet. Drag items onto it from another report for the same day, or select them there and choose Move. Wrong committee: delete this report and make another.

newReport.deleteFailed: The report could not be deleted.

undo.unexportBody: Voucher {voucher} stays in Fortnox. All this does is stop the app counting the day as exported. Export again and you get a second voucher, so reverse the first one in Fortnox before you do.
undo.reopenBody: The voucher and the booked income statement are deleted, and the day rejoins the To book queue. It waits there until you book it again, or until the next fetch clears the queue.
undo.deleteBody: {unit}'s report, its sold items and its voucher are removed. You cannot undo that. Fetching the same period again does bring the day back.
